category.leaf: 女式轻薄连帽防晒外套

description: 可拆帽檐、帽顶发孔拉链、指扣袖口与多口袋的轻薄连帽外套套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and detail grids, pale sky #CFE4F1 for claim and spec panels, deep slate #22455C for the closing flat lay
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright high-key studio light from a large front softbox with a low-power fill card; outdoor shots run a hard 6000K coastal key with unseen bounce; texture revealed only with skimming light
styleLock.surfaceSystem: pale sand #E8DCC6 underfoot in the lifestyle scene, matte white seamless floor elsewhere
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; one headline slot plus two or three short label slots, every rendered word carried by a placeholder
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and straight ray arrows in the accent tint, flat, no 3D, no glossy badges
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 worn angle and always-visible hood and front zipper; garment never hidden by props; no identifiable face in any frame; fabric kept matte with visible topstitch
noDrift: no rating numbers, index badges or percentage marks
no identifiable model faces or retouched skin
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool daylight sport-apparel visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, pale sky blue #CFE4F1, deep slate #22455C and one warm sun accent #E9A63C; bright high-key studio lighting from a large front softbox with a low-power fill card, hard 6000K coastal key only in the outdoor scene, skimming light only for fabric texture; modern geometric sans-serif with headline and short label slots kept as placeholders; thin single-weight line icon style with flat straight ray arrows; real fabric drape with visible topstitch and matte finish; stable slight 3/4 worn angle with hood and front zipper always readable; generous negative space reserved for copy; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no rating numbers or index badges, no identifiable faces.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用真人上身交代连帽、全拉链与修身廓形
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, torso turned a slight 3/4 to camera left, waist-up crop
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, large front softbox key with low-power fill card, soft fabric shadows only
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, even margins around the silhouette
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce apparel packshot of {product} worn by a generic model whose head is cropped above the jaw so nobody is identifiable. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level camera with the torso turned a slight 3/4 to camera left, front zipper pulled closed and the hood resting open across the back of the neck, one hand resting at the hip pocket. Bright even high-key studio light from a large front softbox with a low-power fill card on the shadow side, soft fabric folds and no hard speculars. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF, no props and no floor reflection. The garment occupies 60-70% of the frame with even margins and no extra whitespace reserved for copy. Negative: no identifiable face, no skin smoothing, no brand plate or hang tag, no watermark, no added props, no cropped sleeve or hem, no grey tinted background.

shots.intent: 一秒讲清核心遮蔽主张，用弧形图形承接最强卖点

shots.lighting: strong warm key from the upper right plus cool ambient fill, readable shadow side
shots.background: pale sky panel #CFE4F1 with a faint hazy horizon band
shots.props: one thin arc graphic, three straight ray arrows, one empty circular seal outline
shots.whitespace: generous negative space across the upper right 40% for copy
shots.textZone: 顶部左区标题位「{selling_point_1}」，右上射线标注位「{callout_1}」，右下空印章框位「{callout_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product} worn by a generic model on the left third of the frame, head cropped above the jaw, one hand raised toward the brow as if against glare. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Slight 3/4 camera at eye level so the shoulder line and hood opening read clearly. Strong warm key light from the upper right with cool ambient fill so the shadow side stays readable. Background pale sky panel #CFE4F1 with a faint hazy horizon band. A thin arc graphic tinted {accent_color} stands in front of the shoulder and turns aside three straight ray arrows; an empty circular seal outline sits at the lower right with nothing inside it. Headline slot reading 「{selling_point_1}」 at the top left, one short label 「{callout_1}」 beside the ray arrows and 「{callout_2}」 inside the empty seal frame. The garment occupies 50-60% of the frame with generous negative space across the upper right 40% for copy. Negative: no index numbers, no percentage marks, no rating badges, no invented test data, no readable brand mark, no second competing claim, no sunburned or blistered skin.

shots.intent: 把外套放进真实暴晒通勤场景，让买家自我代入
shots.camera: low angle from hip height looking gently upward, full body in frame
shots.lighting: hard midday coastal sunlight from camera right at 6000K with unseen bounce filling the shadow side
shots.background: pale sand #E8DCC6 foreground, low sea horizon line and soft haze sky
shots.props: flat white trainers only, nothing held in the hands
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, horizon kept clean but empty of copy
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene of {product} worn by a generic model walking on a bright open beach, full body in frame and head cropped above the jaw. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Low-angle camera placed at hip height looking gently upward so the figure reads tall against the horizon. Hard midday coastal sunlight from camera right at 6000K, an unseen bounce card lifting the shadow side, natural cast shadow landing on the sand under both feet. Foreground pale sand #E8DCC6, a low sea horizon line and soft haze sky behind. Props: flat white trainers only, hands free of any bag. The figure and garment occupy 40-50% of the frame with no extra whitespace reserved for copy. Negative: no identifiable face, no crowd or other beachgoers, no signage on the beach, no cap or sunglasses hiding the hood, no floating feet without contact shadow, no text overlay.

shots.intent: 补全背面信息，消除版型与帽子垂坠的下单疑虑

shots.lighting: even high-key studio light wrapping from the front-left, soft shadow under the hem
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, symmetrical margins on both sides

Straight-on rear camera at eye level, photographed from behind so the whole back panel and the hood lying open across the upper back are visible, no profile of the face showing. Even high-key studio light wrapping from the front-left so the side seams stay readable, soft shadow only beneath the hem. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF with no props. shots.intent: 用微距证明帽檐可拆与帽顶发孔的真实做工
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, tight zoom on the crown opening, camera looking down at a high 45-degree angle
shots.lighting: skimming light from camera left across the fabric face, soft falloff to the right
shots.background: pale cool panel #DCE9F2 with one clean inset frame
shots.props: one generic hand lifting the detached brim
shots.whitespace: minimal, the detail is the subject, only two small label slots
shots.textZone: 两枚内嵌图下方标签位「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the hood crown where a narrow zip opening sits and on the brim edge being lifted free of the hood. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Camera pressed in close and looking down at a high 45-degree angle onto the crown, shallow depth of field at f/2.8 with the zipper slider and the stitch line in sharp focus and the background falling off. Skimming light from camera left across the fabric face to open up the fine knit texture, soft falloff toward the right. Background pale cool panel #DCE9F2 with one clean inset frame holding the second macro. A single generic hand with short natural nails lifts the brim; two short labels 「{callout_3}」 and 「{callout_4}」 sit under the two inset frames. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with minimal whitespace since the detail is the subject. Negative: no extra or fused fingers, no glossy manicure, no visible eyes or face, no invented hole geometry, no blurry subject, no watermark, no dense body text.

shots.intent: 把袖口与收纳结构拆成三格，讲清穿着与携带方式
shots.camera: triplet of tight-zoom panels, cuff panel at a clean 90-degree side profile and the two pocket panels straight-on at chest height
shots.lighting: even soft studio light with low fill so topstitch and pocket welts stay legible, no hard speculars
shots.background: pure white #FFFFFF panels separated by hairline gutters
shots.props: one generic hand per panel, plain card in a pocket
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace inside each panel, labels sit below
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce detail triplet for {product}: three matched tight-zoom panels showing the extended cuff with a thumb opening, a hand sliding into an inner pocket and a zippered side pocket. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The cuff panel photographed from a clean 90-degree side profile, the two pocket panels shot straight-on at chest height, all three sharing the same scale. Even soft studio light with a low fill so topstitch and pocket welts stay legible and no hard speculars appear on the zipper teeth. Background pure white #FFFFFF panels separated by hairline gutters. One generic hand per panel, a plain card sitting in one pocket. Labels 「{callout_5}」, 「{callout_6}」 and 「{callout_7}」 sit beneath their own panels. Each panel keeps the garment at 55-60% of its own area with no extra whitespace. Negative: no hands with extra fingers, no face in any panel, no device branding or camera module, no invented pocket count, no mismatched scale between panels, no watermark, no overlapping text.

shots.intent: 用结构化表格承接选码疑问，数值一律留空由卖家填

shots.lighting: flat even light with no directional shadow so the grid stays readable
shots.background: pale sky panel #CFE4F1 with a deep slate #22455C rounded header bar
shots.props: five-row empty table grid, one garment cutout
shots.whitespace: clear margin around the grid, no extra whitespace elsewhere
shots.textZone: 顶部栏标题位「{callout_8}」，左侧首个行标签位「{callout_9}」，其余单元格全空
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce size-spec infographic built around {product} as a single garment cutout standing at the right edge of the layout. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level camera for the panel itself, with the cutout shown at a slight 3/4 and its full length visible. Flat even light with no directional shadow so the grid stays readable. Background pale sky panel #CFE4F1 carrying a deep slate #22455C rounded header bar across the top. A five-row table with thin column dividers fills the left two thirds and every measurement cell is left empty, no digits and no unit marks anywhere; the header title slot reads 「{callout_8}」 and the first left-hand row label slot reads 「{callout_9}」, the remaining row labels stay as identical blank slots. Table and cutout together occupy 55-60% of the frame with a clear margin around the grid. Negative: no invented measurements, no digits, no unit symbols, no tolerance note, no model face, no dense body text, no watermark.

shots.intent: 收口促单，用整件平铺与空白按钮位承接行动指令
shots.camera: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, full flat lay
shots.lighting: soft even top light with a very low fill so the fabric reads matte, contact shadow hugging the lay
shots.background: deep slate #22455C panel with a slim accent rule and one blank rounded button shape
shots.whitespace: generous negative space across the top 30% for copy
shots.textZone: 顶部标题位「{selling_point_2}」，按钮内文案位留空
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce promo close of {product}, the jacket laid fully flat and neatly smoothed on a deep slate panel. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle with the zipper squared to the vertical axis and the hood fanned open at the top. Soft even top light with a very low fill so the fabric reads matte, a slim contact shadow hugging the flat lay so nothing floats. Background deep slate #22455C with a thin accent rule and one blank rounded button shape below the hem. A short headline slot reads 「{selling_point_2}」 and the button shape stays empty with no characters drawn inside it. The flat-laid garment occupies 35-40% of the frame with generous negative space across the top 30% for copy. Negative: no discount figures, no percentage symbols, no countdown graphics, no invented urgency badges, no creases or rumpled sleeves, no floating garment without contact shadow, no watermark.

provenance.notes: 7 张源图逐图事实：001 白底真人上身正面 3/4、手扶帽檐另一手插侧袋；002 同白底背面、帽身摊开在肩背；003 海滩全身场景、球鞋与百褶短裙搭配；004 光照卖点图，人物抬手挡强光、弧形图形把三条射线弹开、右下角圆形印章与顶部大标题；005 主图加两枚内嵌细节（帽顶拉链孔、可拆帽檐）配标签；006 主图加三枚内嵌细节（袖口指扣、内袋、侧袋）配标签；007 深色表头加五行规格的尺码表格，人物半身在表格右侧重叠。品类判定依据：结构细节（指扣袖口、帽顶发孔、可拆帽檐、贴身多口袋、细网眼织纹）与海滩强光全身场景都指向户外运动穿着语境，非时装廓形与都市搭配，故落 运动户外/服饰 而非 女装/外套；源平台类目字样与源标题仅作线索，不作为判定依据。变体闸门核对：7 图构图与角色互不相同（正面/背面/场景/主张图/两组细节格/规格表），不存在多数同图仅换色的色卡陈列，故正常转化。已剥离内容：源品牌字标与胸前小标、原平台店铺字样、模特面容与身份（全部改为颈部以上裁切或背面、无识别特征）、源图全部英文原句文案、圆形印章与射线上的防护等级数值与角标符号、尺码表内全部具体数字与误差说明句；以上一律以 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 占位或改为空白单元格与空印章框。与库内既有外套模版的暖米色、驼色、深色绒感色板区隔，本套锁定冷调晴空蓝加深石青加暖阳金强调。产品一律以 {product} 占位，场景、构图、光位与排版结构为可复用部分。
